Effects The munagola Strides or Flies up to their Speed, following the retreating foe and keeping it in reach until the foe stops moving or the munagola has moved their full Speed.

items.name: Felling Assault
items.text:
When a munagola hits with a melee Strike, they gain Improved Knockdown on all subsequent melee Strikes against that target until the end of the munagola's turn.

Effect: Felling Assault

items.name: Flames of Fury
items.text: Any weapon a munagola holds gains the effects of a Flaming rune while they hold it.

items.name: Flight Commander of Dis
items.text:
The munagola directs aerial maneuvers, granting themself and unholy allies with fly Speeds within 30 feet a +20-foot status bonus to their fly Speeds for 1 round.

Effect: Flight Commander of Dis

items.name: Sudden Dive
items.text: The munagola Flies twice. If they end their flight at a lower elevation than they started and within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to the Strike.

text:
Munagolas are some of the most feared fiendish warriors in Hell, for they combine the aerial strength and craftiness of erinyes with sheer brute force rivaling that of the strongest devils. The first munagola was forged by Eiseth, Hell's Valkyrie, from the flesh of other devils. The process took centuries but resulted in a loyal soldier to rival her own rage and might. Since she established her realm in Dis, Eiseth has created armies of executioner devils to serve her will.

Munagolas are vicious combatants, empowered by their fury and growing stronger with each successful blow, but their true strength lies in their commanding presence on the battlefield. They often lead troops of other flying devils from the front, driving them to faster and deadlier assaults that leave the enemies of their queen with no chance to respond.

Munagolas and erinyes who serve Eiseth work well together, though a few munagolas hold contempt for the members of the Golden Company, believing their ostentatious armor to belittle the glory of battle. However, even such devils can't argue with the Golden Company's results.
